title: Compare the selected EV coverage package
benefit_hypothesis: A voluntary comparison could make limits, deductible and repair eligibility understandable.
strongest_rival: Existing insurer RIPLAY already provides the terms; customers may understand them or prioritize price.
existing_capability: Existing Zurich product and summary; no new product category claimed.
conditional_economic_link: Only incremental eligible sales/fees or retained repair contribution, after costs; fee share unknown.
kill_condition: No consequential misunderstanding or permissible added dealer role.
overlap: May refine an existing competition option; do not count as globally novel feature

title: Clarify warranty, covered damage and resale-risk boundaries
benefit_hypothesis: Route an unresolved question to the party that controls the relevant promise.
strongest_rival: Existing warranty/insurer/appraiser advice may be sufficient.
existing_capability: Existing motor cover, OEM programmes and international RVI remain distinct.
conditional_economic_link: Possible reduction in repeated handling or retained suitable demand; no measured uplift.
kill_condition: No current confusion or decision consequence.
overlap: May refine an existing competition option; do not count as globally novel feature

title: Connect an existing insurer claim to an eligible repair job
benefit_hypothesis: An additional dealer role might preserve authorized repair context.
strongest_rival: AMC/myGarda already provide claims and repair status; integration may duplicate them.
existing_capability: Existing insurer channels and workshop authorization are the baseline.
conditional_economic_link: Only captured authorized jobs or realizable handling savings; insurer decisions and costs remain external.
kill_condition: No specific broken handoff, data permission or accepted repair route.
overlap: May refine an existing competition option; do not count as globally novel feature

title: Consider a plainly capped trade-in benefit
benefit_hypothesis: A limited commercial benefit could matter to a next-purchase decision.
strongest_rival: It may only subsidize already loyal buyers or attract adverse redemptions.
existing_capability: Manufacturer resale programmes are precedents, not equivalent Auto2000 offers.
conditional_economic_link: Incremental delivered contribution minus actual top-up and associated costs; no assumed repeat-sale incrementality.
kill_condition: Expected and stressed subsidy exceed additional contribution, or consumers misunderstand the cap.
overlap: May refine an existing competition option; do not count as globally novel feature

title: Investigate a full residual floor as a different obligation
benefit_hypothesis: A qualifying minimum could address uncertainty if demand and funding exist.
strongest_rival: Eligibility is restrictive, price declines and exercise may co-move, and no feasible funding exists.
existing_capability: Hyundai detailed terms and VinFast qualified headline are distinct manufacturer precedents.
conditional_economic_link: Additional contribution must exceed retained loss, capital, administration and any cover premium.
kill_condition: No valid economic exposure estimate or credible capacity to honor the full customer promise.
overlap: May refine an existing competition option; do not count as globally novel feature

title: Investigate a bespoke B2B risk-transfer layer
benefit_hypothesis: An actual insurer contract might transfer some eligible residual exposure.
strongest_rival: No suitable locally available product, acceptable risk definition or affordable contribution exists.
existing_capability: International custom B2B RVI is confirmed; local syariah availability is unresolved.
conditional_economic_link: Net benefit depends on recoverable claims minus premium, exclusions, timing and retained exposure.
kill_condition: No verified underwriting offer or product-specific regulatory/sharia basis.
overlap: May refine an existing competition option; do not count as globally novel feature

title: Treat syariah preference as a real priced choice
benefit_hypothesis: Voluntary choice may serve some buyers when real benefits and contributions are clear.
strongest_rival: Religious population share need not predict actual product selection.
existing_capability: Existing syariah motor products; no automatic dealer fee or approval.
conditional_economic_link: Only actual incremental fee/vehicle/repair contribution; not all insurer revenue.
kill_condition: Preference disappears with realistic contribution and exclusion information.
overlap: May refine an existing competition option; do not count as globally novel feature

title: Explain how much of a promise remains outside insurance
benefit_hypothesis: Separate customer floor, insurer recovery, workshop eligibility and out-of-pocket amounts.
strongest_rival: Existing contracts may already explain the limits adequately.
existing_capability: Existing product deductibles and customized RVI illustrate separate obligations.
conditional_economic_link: Potential lower rework or better suitable choice; no standalone GP assumption.
kill_condition: No consequential boundary confusion or information is unavailable/unreliable.
overlap: May refine an existing competition option; do not count as globally novel feature
